title: ADP Workforce Now Review (2026)
intro: ADP Workforce Now is evaluated here as a payroll and benefits administration platform — ADP Workforce Now is ADP’s mid-to-enterprise HCM for payroll, tax filing, HR records, benefits, and optional time/talent modules. Industry coverage consistently describes three named packages — Select (payroll + core HR), Plus (benefits), Premium (time & workforce) — all contact-sales. First-party pages do not publish PEPM. Score as payroll-benefits landscape (compliance-scale), not a Gusto SMB award peer and not a Workday enterprise-HCM peer. This review uses SoftwareGlimpse’s HR methodology (ease of use, hiring/workforce fit, workflow depth, integrations, mobile/frontline, analytics, scalability, value, AI), scoring products inside their job cluster rather than against unrelated peers. It is based on first-party research, not hands-on lab testing.
summary: Choose ADP Workforce Now when mid-market payroll compliance and HR records are the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need Gusto’s published SMB prices or Workday-class HCM.
verdict: Choose ADP Workforce Now when mid-market payroll compliance and HR records are the job and you will take a custom quote — not when you need Gusto’s published SMB prices or Workday-class HCM. Compare Gusto for published US SMB payroll, Paylocity / Paycor for mid-market HCM UX, and Workday/UKG if enterprise HCM is the real job. Scores reflect first-party documentation as of 2026-08-17 — not hands-on product testing. Confirm current packaging, minimums and usage rates on the vendor site before purchase.

criterionAssessments.rationale: Mid-market payroll+HR is heavier than Gusto, lighter than Workday. Not lab-tested.
Primary job is payroll-benefits at mid-market compliance scale. Scored inside payroll-benefits — Gusto keeps the published-SMB award.
Payroll, tax, and HR records are deep. Talent/time sit on higher packages.
Payroll/benefits/401(k) ecosystem is a category strength.
Employee self-service and mobile payroll/HR exist; not deskless WFM.
Benchmark reporting against ADP’s dataset is marketed; not people-science Culture Amp.
Designed past Gusto’s SMB comfort zone into multi-state mid-market.
Opaque PEPM and add-ons vs Gusto’s $49+$6 published floor. Affiliate economics excluded.
Assistive payroll/HR AI is marketed without a first-party named AI SKU like Bryte or Ignite.
